entries.f342e8707b454fb2: The medium-term management plan (fiscal years ended March 2026 to March 2028), with the fiscal year ended March 2026 as its first year, sets three basic policies: 'Strengthening returns through focusing on growth businesses and improving the earnings power of existing businesses,' 'Implementing a new capital policy,' and 'Evolving into a corporate governance structure that reliably executes the new medium-term plan.'
